# Mal Al Sham — The Taste of Damascus

> Family-owned Syrian & Mediterranean restaurant in El Cajon, California. Founded 2018 by Mr. Ahmed Abu Ali. 100% Halal. Open daily 9 AM – 10 PM. Located at 388 E Main St, El Cajon, CA 92020. Phone: (619) 401-1055.

## Identity

- **Restaurant:** Mal Al Sham (مطعم مال الشام)
- **Tagline:** The Taste of Damascus, served in El Cajon
- **Cuisine:** Syrian / Mediterranean / Lebanese — 100% Halal
- **Founded:** 2018
- **Founder:** Ahmed Abu Ali (family emigrated from Syria, 2016)
- **Address:** 388 E Main St, El Cajon, CA 92020
- **Phone:** +1 (619) 401-1055
- **Email:** info@malalsham.com
- **Hours:** Monday – Sunday, 9:00 AM – 10:00 PM
- **Price range:** $$ (Shawarma sandwich $12)
- **Reviews:** 1,500+ five-star · 3,131 aggregate · 4.4/5 average
- **Recognition:** Featured on Eater San Diego (twice); "Best Arab Restaurant in America" (Minnesota Tours); 5/5 (The Nexus)

## Signature dishes

- **Beef Shawarma** ($17.99) — marinated thinly sliced beef, slow-rotated, with tahina sauce.
- **Chicken Shawarma Sandwich** ($12) — with fries and house sauce.
- **Mixed Grill Special** ($23.99) — beef kabob, chicken kabob, beef tikka, chicken tikka.
- **Mal Al Sham Falafel** ($10.99) — twelve chickpea fritters in our spice blend.
- **Mansaf** — slow-cooked lamb over short rice with jameed yogurt sauce. **Friday – Sunday only.**
- **Ghouzi (Ouzi)** — whole slow-roasted lamb over rice. **Friday – Sunday only.**
- **Hummus** — stone-milled chickpeas, tahina, lemon, olive oil.

## Family & party platters

- **Al Sham Basmati Chicken Tray** — serves 6.
- **Al Sham Basmati Lamb Tray** — serves 6.
- **Mansaf Chicken Platter** — serves 10.
- **Mansaf Lamb Platter** — serves 10.
- **Family Combo for 5** — kabobs, tikka, shawarma, rice, salad.
- **Mega Combo** — serves 5 – 6, fully loaded.
